## What will fight you

The channel-lever hub **length** sets the .300 in (7.62 mm) channel pitch and the error stacks nineteen times: the 20 lever hubs stack face to face on their shaft. The 20 rocker-arm hubs (`ch-rocker-hub` on the built-up route) are shorter than the pitch: each rocker floats on its shaft and takes its place from its connecting rod, whose ring slides between two cylinder gears. The rocker's R800 top edge is a profile, not a pocket. Make all twenty of a part in one session, on one setup, or accept drift.
